```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Read pipeline-specific values written by the Nextflow process
source("_params.R")

library(knitr)
opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
               fig.align = "center", out.width = "95%")

# ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
count_nonempty <- function(f) {
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(0L)
  sum(nchar(trimws(readLines(f, warn = FALSE))) > 0L)
}

safe_read <- function(f, ...) {
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
  tryCatch(read.table(f, ...), error = function(e) NULL)
}

read_id_pairs <- function(f) {
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(character(0))
  lines <- grep("\\S", readLines(f, warn = FALSE), value = TRUE)
  unique(sapply(strsplit(lines, "\\s+"), function(x) paste(x[1], x[2])))
}

null_display <- function(x, fallback = "not set") {
  if (is.null(x) || identical(x, "null") || identical(x, NA_character_)) fallback
  else as.character(x)
}

# ── Final dataset counts ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
final_samples  <- count_nonempty(final_fam)
final_variants <- count_nonempty(final_bim)
excl_samples   <- count_nonempty("all_excluded_samples.txt")
excl_variants  <- count_nonempty("all_excluded_variants.txt")
```

```{r attrition-data, include=FALSE}
# ── Parse all *summary*.txt files ─────────────────────────────────────────────
variant_steps <- c("duplicate_variant_check", "variant_callrate",
                   "hwe_filter", "maf_filter", "imputation_filter", "cc_miss_test")
sample_steps  <- c("sample_callrate", "sex_check", "heterozygosity",
                   "relatedness", "ancestry_pca")

atr_rows <- list()
for (f in sort(list.files(".", pattern = ".*summary.*\\.txt$"))) {
  lines <- readLines(f, warn = FALSE)
  data  <- list()
  for (line in lines) {
    line <- trimws(line)
    if (grepl("=", line, fixed = TRUE)) {
      kv <- strsplit(line, "=", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
      data[[trimws(kv[1])]] <- trimws(paste(kv[-1], collapse = "="))
    }
  }
  step  <- if (!is.null(data[["step"]])) data[["step"]] else sub("\\.txt$", "", f)
  phase <- if (step %in% variant_steps) "variant"
           else if (step %in% sample_steps) "sample"
           else "input"
  for (key in setdiff(names(data), c("step", "file"))) {
    atr_rows[[length(atr_rows) + 1]] <-
      data.frame(Phase = phase, Step = step, Metric = key,
                 Value = data[[key]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
}

atr_rows[[length(atr_rows) + 1]] <-
  data.frame(Phase="final", Step="cleaned_data", Metric="n_samples",
             Value=as.character(final_samples), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
atr_rows[[length(atr_rows) + 1]] <-
  data.frame(Phase="final", Step="cleaned_data", Metric="n_variants",
             Value=as.character(final_variants), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
atr_rows[[length(atr_rows) + 1]] <-
  data.frame(Phase="final", Step="exclusions", Metric="n_excluded_samples",
             Value=as.character(excl_samples), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
atr_rows[[length(atr_rows) + 1]] <-
  data.frame(Phase="final", Step="exclusions", Metric="n_excluded_variants",
             Value=as.character(excl_variants), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

atr_df <- do.call(rbind, atr_rows)

# Write attrition TSV
write.table(atr_df, "qc_attrition_table.tsv",
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = c("phase", "step", "metric", "value"))
```

```{r thresholds-data, include=FALSE}
# ── Thresholds table ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
thresh_list <- list(
  chroms               = chroms,
  sample_qc_scope      = qc_scope,
  run_variant_qc       = run_variant_qc,
  run_sample_qc        = run_sample_qc,
  sample_missingness   = sample_missingness,
  variant_missingness  = variant_missingness,
  cc_miss_p            = null_display(cc_miss_p),
  hwe_p_autosomes      = hwe_p,
  hwe_p_chrx           = null_display(hwe_p_chrx, "same as autosomes"),
  maf                  = maf,
  heterozygosity_sd    = heterozygosity_sd,
  relatedness_pi_hat   = relatedness_pi_hat,
  sex_f_lower_female   = sex_f_female,
  sex_f_upper_male     = sex_f_male,
  pca_outlier_sd       = pca_outlier_sd,
  ld_regions           = null_display(ld_regions, "not provided"),
  reference_panel      = null_display(reference_panel, "not provided")
)
thresh_df <- data.frame(
  Parameter = names(thresh_list),
  Value     = unlist(lapply(thresh_list, as.character)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names = NULL
)
write.table(thresh_df, "qc_thresholds.tsv",
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r persample-data, include=FALSE}
# ── Per-sample QC table (only when sample QC modules have run) ─────────────────
imiss_df <- safe_read("sample_missingness.imiss", header = TRUE)
het_df   <- safe_read("heterozygosity.het",       header = TRUE)
sex_df   <- safe_read("sex_check.sexcheck",       header = TRUE)

smiss_ids   <- read_id_pairs("sample_callrate_removed.txt")
het_ids     <- read_id_pairs("heterozygosity_outliers.txt")
sex_ids     <- read_id_pairs("sex_discordant.txt")
related_ids <- read_id_pairs("relatedness_remove.txt")
anc_ids     <- read_id_pairs("ancestry_outliers.txt")

sample_qc_run <- !is.null(imiss_df) || !is.null(het_df) || !is.null(sex_df)

ps_df <- NULL
if (sample_qc_run) {
  all_keys <- unique(c(
    if (!is.null(imiss_df)) paste(imiss_df$FID, imiss_df$IID) else NULL,
    if (!is.null(het_df))   paste(het_df$FID,   het_df$IID)   else NULL,
    if (!is.null(sex_df))   paste(sex_df$FID,   sex_df$IID)   else NULL
  ))

  rows <- lapply(all_keys, function(key) {
    parts <- strsplit(key, " ")[[1]]; fid <- parts[1]; iid <- parts[2]

    f_miss <- if (!is.null(imiss_df)) {
      r <- imiss_df[imiss_df$FID == fid & imiss_df$IID == iid, "F_MISS"]
      if (length(r) > 0) sprintf("%.4f", r[1]) else NA_character_
    } else NA_character_

    het_r <- if (!is.null(het_df)) {
      r <- het_df[het_df$FID == fid & het_df$IID == iid, ]
      if (nrow(r) > 0) sprintf("%.4f", (r$N.NM.[1] - r$O.HOM.[1]) / r$N.NM.[1]) else NA_character_
    } else NA_character_

    x_f <- pedsex <- snpsex <- sex_st <- NA_character_
    if (!is.null(sex_df)) {
      sr <- sex_df[sex_df$FID == fid & sex_df$IID == iid, ]
      if (nrow(sr) > 0) {
        pedsex <- as.character(sr$PEDSEX[1])
        snpsex <- as.character(sr$SNPSEX[1])
        x_f    <- if ("F" %in% names(sr)) sprintf("%.3f", sr$F[1]) else NA_character_
        sex_st <- as.character(sr$STATUS[1])
      }
    }

    flag <- function(ids) if (key %in% ids) "YES" else "NO"
    sm <- flag(smiss_ids); ho <- flag(het_ids); sd <- flag(sex_ids)
    rr <- flag(related_ids); ao <- flag(anc_ids)
    qf <- if (any(c(sm, ho, sd, rr, ao) == "YES")) "YES" else "NO"
    batch <- {
      p <- strsplit(fid, "-")[[1]]
      if (length(p) >= 3) paste(p[1:2], collapse="-") else fid
    }
    data.frame(FID=fid, IID=iid, F_MISS=f_miss, HET_RATE=het_r, X_F=x_f,
               PEDSEX=pedsex, SNPSEX=snpsex, SEX_STATUS=sex_st,
               SMISS=sm, HET_OUT=ho, SEX_DISC=sd, RELATED=rr,
               ANC_OUT=ao, QC_FAIL=qf, BATCH=batch,
               stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  })
  ps_df <- do.call(rbind, rows)

  write.table(ps_df, "qc_per_sample.tsv",
              sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Per-sample table:", nrow(ps_df), "samples\n")

  # Per-batch summary
  batch_n    <- table(ps_df$BATCH)
  batch_fail <- tapply(ps_df$QC_FAIL == "YES", ps_df$BATCH, sum)
  batch_df <- data.frame(
    Batch   = names(batch_n),
    N       = as.integer(batch_n),
    Removed = as.integer(batch_fail[names(batch_n)]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  batch_df$Pass     <- batch_df$N - batch_df$Removed
  batch_df$Pass_pct <- sprintf("%.1f%%", batch_df$Pass / batch_df$N * 100)
  write.table(batch_df, "qc_per_batch.tsv",
              sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
} else {
  # Still write empty TSVs so Nextflow outputs are satisfied
  writeLines("FID\tIID\tF_MISS\tHET_RATE\tX_F\tPEDSEX\tSNPSEX\tSEX_STATUS\tSMISS\tHET_OUT\tSEX_DISC\tRELATED\tANC_OUT\tQC_FAIL\tBATCH",
             "qc_per_sample.tsv")
  writeLines("Batch\tN\tRemoved\tPass\tPass_pct", "qc_per_batch.tsv")
  cat("Sample QC not run — per-sample table empty\n")
}
```

---

**Dataset:** `r dataset_id` $\quad$ **Chromosomes:** `r chroms` $\quad$ **Sample QC scope:** `r qc_scope`

`r if (qc_scope == "provisional") "\\textbf{\\color{red}{Warning: provisional scope — not all autosomes analysed. Results are indicative only.}}" else ""`

# QC Plots

```{r plots, results='asis'}
plot_order <- c("miss_het_scatter","heterozygosity_plot","sex_check_F_stat",
                "vmiss_plot","cc_miss_plot","maf_plot","hwe_plot",
                "imputation_r2_plot","relatedness_pi_hat","pca_scree","pca_plot")

sort_key <- function(f) {
  n <- sub("\\.png$", "", basename(f))
  i <- match(n, plot_order)
  if (is.na(i)) length(plot_order) + 1L else i
}

pngs <- list.files(".", pattern = "\\.png$", full.names = FALSE)
pngs <- pngs[order(sapply(pngs, sort_key))]

for (i in seq_along(pngs)) {
  f     <- pngs[i]
  label <- tools::toTitleCase(gsub("_", " ", sub("\\.png$", "", basename(f))))
  cat(sprintf("\n## %s\n\n", label))
  # knit_child spawns a proper figure chunk for each PNG so knitr wraps it in
  # a LaTeX figure environment with caption — plain print(include_graphics())
  # inside results='asis' bypasses that and produces no figure environment.
  cat(knitr::knit_child(
    text  = sprintf(
      '```{r plot-%d, echo=FALSE, fig.cap="%s", out.width="90%%"}\nknitr::include_graphics("%s")\n```',
      i, label, f
    ),
    quiet = TRUE,
    envir = environment()
  ))
  cat("\n\n")
}

if (length(pngs) == 0) cat("_No QC plots were produced._\n")
```
